traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Action (Button, Link, None), hasPreamble, hasLeadingAsset and three slots cover promo, info and up-sell banners without detaching.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Colours, type and radius are bound, and the action is a library Button - XSmall. But Pressed and Disabled are drawn with a blended copy of the artwork, and the card is fixed at 160 tall.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Action, State and imagePosition are clean, but hasLeadingAsset is a False / True variant, the slots are not in the ⤷ …Slot form, and spacer instances carry the rhythm.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Artwork, leading asset and icon are real slots, and the action is a Button - XSmall instance rather than a drawn link.

behavior.notes: Resting card. With an Action the whole banner is the tap target.
Drawn as a 60% copy of the artwork with a Linear Burn blend, darkening the card. No token; native needs its own pressed treatment.
A 40% artwork copy washes the card out, and every text layer drops to 47% opacity.
No focus treatment in the set.
Button is a Button - XSmall text link with a chevron in Icon Slot; Link is the label alone; None has no action row.

resolved.headline: Property names use spaces.
resolved.body: v2.0: with link, with button, with preamble and with icon are gone; the set uses Action, hasPreamble and hasLeadingAsset — checked on node 4430:14807 (C2)

resolved.headline: Property is a meta-name, not a semantic one.
resolved.body: v2.0: the Property axis (Within A Container / Full Width) is removed; the banner is one rounded card — checked on node 4430:14807 (C2)

resolved.headline: with link + with button encode mutually exclusive CTAs as independent booleans.
resolved.body: v2.0: one Action setting — Button, None, Link — so a link and a button can no longer both be on — checked on node 4430:14807 (C2)

resolved.headline: Container padding modeled as a component variant.
resolved.body: v2.0: removed with the Property axis; outer padding belongs to the parent layout — checked on node 4430:14807 (C4)

resolved.headline: Sparse cartesian variant space.
resolved.body: v2.0: 64 possible combinations are now 24 built variants: imagePosition × State × four Action / hasLeadingAsset pairings. The remaining gap is filed below — checked on node 4430:14807 (C1)

resolved.headline: No first-class image slot.
resolved.body: v2.0: the artwork sits in Asset Slot, a real slot — checked on node 4430:14807 (C4)

resolved.headline: with icon=yes renders a drawn grey circle.
resolved.body: v2.0: the leading icon is Leading Asset Slot, holding a swappable Placeholder instance — checked on node 4430:14807 (C6)

resolved.headline: Chevron is a raster shape_full PNG.
resolved.body: v2.0: the arrow is a Chevron Right Small vector instance in Icon Slot, on border/color-border-primary — checked on node 4430:14807 (C6)

resolved.headline: No pressed / focused / disabled states.
resolved.body: v2.0: State = Default, Pressed, Disabled. Focused is not drawn — see the open state issue — checked on node 4430:14807 (C5)

open.headline: The banner is fixed at 160 tall.
open.body: All 24 variants are 360 × 160 with fixed sizing, so the card cannot grow with its copy and the Link and None variants leave empty space under the text. Set the container to hug its content.

open.headline: Spacer instances carry the vertical rhythm.
open.body: content stacks _space_2 (42 across the set) and _space_16 (6) instances between its text layers — raw #FF0000 and #7000FF boxes. The layout gap should carry the spacing.

open.headline: A leading asset only exists without an action.
open.body: hasLeadingAsset is a False / True variant, and True is built only with Action=None, so a banner cannot have a leading icon and a Button or Link. Make it a boolean so it combines with every Action.

open.headline: Slot names do not follow the library form.
open.body: Asset Slot, Leading Asset Slot and Icon Slot use spaces, where Table, Modal and Checkbox Item name theirs ⤷ AssetSlot. The set also mixes Container and container.

open.headline: Pressed and Disabled are drawn with a blended copy of the artwork.
open.body: Each state adds an Overlay frame holding a second copy of the image — 60% with a Linear Burn blend for Pressed, 40% for Disabled, with the text at 47%. No token describes either state, Linear Burn has no SwiftUI or Compose equivalent, and Focused is not drawn.

recommendations.headline: Let the banner hug its content.
recommendations.body: Switch the container from fixed 160 to hug, so long copy grows the card and short copy does not leave a gap.

recommendations.headline: Replace the spacer instances with auto-layout gap.
recommendations.body: Set the gaps on content and delete the _space_2 / _space_16 instances.

recommendations.headline: Make hasLeadingAsset a boolean.
recommendations.body: A boolean property combines with every Action, and drops the variant count from 24 to 18.

recommendations.headline: Name the slots in the library form.
recommendations.body: ⤷ AssetSlot, ⤷ LeadingAssetSlot, ⤷ IconSlot, matching Table and Modal.

recommendations.headline: Draw Pressed and Disabled with tokens.
recommendations.body: A token-bound state layer (or the Button family’s pressed and disabled tokens) in place of the blended artwork copy, so both platforms can reproduce them; add Focused if keyboard navigation is in scope.

recommendations.headline: Decide whether a full-width banner is still needed.
recommendations.body: The rebuild dropped the old Full Width option, but the In Context screens still show edge-to-edge banners (Invite friends to GForest, Pay with GCash).

recommendations.headline: Consolidate with Carousel - Item.
recommendations.body: Both components have preamble / heading / description / button / image-with-position slots. The only difference is peek/snap behaviour — which belongs on the carousel container (scroll snap + scale/opacity transforms), not a sibling component. Target: one EBBanner used standalone or inside EBCarousel.

recommendations.headline: Announce as a single actionable element.
recommendations.body: VoiceOver and TalkBack should read preamble + heading + description + action label as one announcement with a button/link role.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Rename space-separated booleans to camelCase.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — hasPreamble and hasLeadingAsset; link and button became Action.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Collapse with link + with button into one action enum.
Replace with icon boolean with a leading asset slot.
Rename Property → drop it or make it padding.
Vectorize the chevron.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied — Chevron Right Small vector instance.

appliedRecommendations.headline: Add pressed + focused states.
appliedRecommendations.body: v2.0: Applied in part — Pressed and Disabled ship; Focused does not.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Banner for a promo or info message between content sections.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use it for an urgent or blocking message — use Alert or Visual Popup.

usageGuidelines.doText: Give it one Action — a Button, a Link, or none.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t add a second call to action inside the artwork or the copy.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the heading to one or two lines and the blurb short — the card is 160 tall.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t bake text into the artwork; put it in the heading and blurb.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use the preamble for context, like the product name (GGives).
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use the preamble as a second heading.

scorecard.notes: container › Asset Slot + content (#preamble, #title, #blurb, learn-more). Fixed at 160 tall, with _space_2 / _space_16 spacer instances carrying the rhythm.
Action, State and imagePosition are clean and hasPreamble is a boolean, but hasLeadingAsset is a False / True variant built only with Action=None, and the slots are not in the ⤷ …Slot form.

Surface bg/color-bg-main, preamble and title text/color-text-stronger, blurb text/color-text-weaker, action text/color-text-primary, chevron border/color-border-primary; the only raw paints are on the spacer instances.
Maps to one EBBanner with an action enum and view-builder slots for the artwork and leading asset.
Default, Pressed and Disabled exist, but Pressed and Disabled are a blended copy of the artwork with no token, and Focused is not drawn.
The artwork and leading asset are slots, and the chevron is a Chevron Right Small vector instance.

variants.description: imagePosition (2) × State (3) × four Action / hasLeadingAsset pairings = 24 variants, all 360 × 160. hasLeadingAsset=True is built only with Action=None.

changelog.header: Component Review against the Working File rebuild · node 4430:14807

rows.body: Repointed to the rebuild. The owner chose the 2026 Working File set 4430:14807 (was 756:82673). Five yes / no axes and Property become imagePosition, Action, State, hasLeadingAsset, hasPreamble and three slots — 24 variants.
Property names use spaces. Resolved by the rebuild.
Property is a meta-name, not a semantic one. Resolved by the rebuild.
with link + with button encode mutually exclusive CTAs as independent booleans. Resolved by the rebuild.
Container padding modeled as a component variant. Resolved by the rebuild.
Sparse cartesian variant space. Resolved by the rebuild.
No first-class image slot. Resolved by the rebuild.
with icon=yes renders a drawn grey circle. Resolved by the rebuild.
Chevron is a raster shape_full PNG. Resolved by the rebuild.
No pressed / focused / disabled states. Resolved by the rebuild.
Five findings filed. Fixed 160 height and spacer instances (C1), hasLeadingAsset as a variant and slot naming (C2), and states drawn with a blended artwork copy (C5).
Restructure · Requires Rework → Fix · Needs Refinement. Reusable and Composable now pass; Self-contained and Consistent are Partial.
Code tab, Live Preview, Playground and In Context rewritten for the rebuild.

Verdict: Restructure — Rename space-separated booleans, collapse link/button into one action enum, add leading asset + background slots, vectorize chevron, add pressed state, consolidate with Carousel - Item. Open
C1 — Sparse cartesian axes — 5 boolean-ish axes × 2 container modes = 64 combos; 20 ship. Invalid combos pruned by convention, not by schema. Open
C2 — Property names with spaces — with link, with button, with preamble, with icon, and meta-named Property. Mutually exclusive CTAs modeled as independent booleans. Open
C4 — Image slot + container-padding axis — Image is a sibling-component instance, not a Figma Slot. Property=Within A Container | Full Width conflates layout with identity. Open
C5 — Missing interaction states — No pressed, focused, or disabled for a tappable banner. Open
C6 — Raster chevron + drawn icon placeholder — Vectorize chevron; swap drawn circle for a leading asset slot. Open
C7 — Code Connect — Blocked on renames, axis collapse, and slot adoption. Open
